name: Sustainability Club
description: Created to promote learning and work towards sustainability at GJU by involving students in real-life exercises; aims to spread sustainability awareness within the GJU community.

name: Innovation Club
description: The club aims to develop and enhance entrepreneurship and innovation skills. The club is a platform for individuals to learn and exchange knowledge in the field of entrepreneurship.

name: Debate Club
description: Platform for students to develop critical thinking, public speaking, and argumentation skills through discussions, workshops, and competitions.

name: Arabic Language Club
description: Interest in Arabic language by celebrating special events and encouraging reading.

name: Biomedical Engineering Club
description: Brings together students interested in medical technology and engineering; builds knowledge and skills via workshops, events, and projects.

name: Business Club
description: Executes activities related to business and mini projects.

name: Camping and Hiking Club
description: Organizes adventure tourism activities (camping, hiking, horseback riding), explores Jordan’s heritage, and runs volunteering initiatives; led by student Hussam Kasasbeh.

name: Communication Club
description: Enhances students’ communication skills and strengthens bonds between international and local students through social, academic, and cultural activities.

name: GJU Dual Studies Club
description: Student-run group supporting first-year students interested in GJU’s Dual Studies Program by offering advice, sharing experiences, and guidance.

name: GDG on Campus GJU Chapter
description: Established in 2024 as the first Google Developer Group at GJU; empowers students with knowledge, tools, and opportunities in technology and innovation.

name: IEEE GJU Student Branch
description: Active IEEE student branch at GJU fostering innovation, professional growth, and technical excellence; the page notes over 145 active IEEE members.
